verdict.rationale: Docs mention a Telemetry toggle to enable/disable sharing interaction logs 'to improve models,' which implies an opt-out from training use, but there's no detail on whether this covers all code/prompts, no admin/org-level enforcement described, and no independent confirmation it works as claimed. missing for 10: explicit statement that opting out excludes code/prompts from training, org-wide/admin-level controls, independent verification of the setting's effect.
